# Template

This repository is a template: new projects are generated from its releases.

| Page | Content |
| --- | --- |
| [Start a new project](start-a-new-project.md) | run the installer, what it changes, what to do after unzipping |
| [Mark a client's passage](mark-a-clients-passage.md) | keep a change of the template right for every choice of clients |

In a generated project, this section is replaced by a single page saying which template version the project came from.
